title: Affine homogeneous generators of a conormal presentation
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z→X and a presentation A of its conormal algebra [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], on an ambient affine U any predicate on A(i⁻¹U) which holds at zero, is preserved by addition, and holds on every homogeneous ideal-power representative holds on every section.

proof.text: Use the affine chart in the conormal presentation to identify sections with the direct sum of the successive ideal-power quotients. Induct on this direct sum, then on each quotient. Lift each ideal-power representative by the power-identification isomorphism and the affine ideal sections. The chart formula identifies its class with the corresponding homogeneous section.

theorem affine_homogeneous_induction {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (A : Presentation i) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (P : A.algebra.right.obj.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) → Prop)
    (hzero : P 0)
    (hhom : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : (power i n).val.obj (op U.1)),
      P (homogeneousClass i A.algebra A.inclusion n U.1 a))
    (hadd : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b))
    (a : A.algebra.right.obj.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))) : P a
